newsitem.title: CHINA: Korea's Sunkyong in China JV trade firm.
newsitem.headline: Korea's Sunkyong in China JV trade firm.

text.p: China has approved the establishment of a Sino-Korean joint venture trading company with a registered capital of 100 million yuan ($12.05 million), a company official said on Monday.
The company would be set up by the China National Technical Import and Export Co (CNTIC) and South Korea's Sunkyong Co in the Pudong new area of Shanghai, a CNTIC official said.
Of the total investment, CNTIC would account for 51 percent, he said. The venture had been approved by the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation (MOFTEC).
It was the third foreign trade joint venture to win approval in China.
